treatment.intent: Test whether the shorter service cap allows all 64 short requests to reside concurrently.

capacity.conclusion: The service cap reduced the reported token count proportionally but did not increase sequence residency. The configured maximum MTP2 state-row allocation remains the limiting resource.

concurrency.reason: The first eligible single-user row failed ordered gate 2; the preregistered wrapper stopped before either c64 request batch.

quality.inherited_code_runtime_evidence: R2 active-width focused test, c2 canary, and 7/7 + repeat 8/8 semantic result

decision.reason: The treatment neither increased reported request residency nor passed the frozen single-user retention gate.
decision.replication: not run by preregistered stop rule
decision.next_treatment: Investigate dynamic per-request Mamba speculative-state allocation; reducing max_model_len is closed.

reporting_boundary: Every rate is directly measured. No c64 performance result exists for R3, and none is interpolated or extrapolated. The capacity conclusion uses the server-reported cache values from R2 and R3.
